svg.title: Run 1 '46521e10-865e-535c-90c0-cc6404c94d2a', frames 493–505 (1.90–2.25 s)
svg.text: 13 presented frames on a 60.00 Hz display (16.7 ms per refresh), one capture per refresh.
The CPU times are on the pacer's clock, placed on the capture's with the markers' intended display times: on-time frames appear at their intended vsync.

g.text: CPU: from the CPU start time for CPU busy, labelled with the frame (#last digits of its index) and its animation time
present: the frame is handed over and waits for its vsync
vsync: bright can be aimed at the frame's target, faint is skipped
the frame's first refresh, within the error threshold
the frame's first refresh, off by more than the error threshold
held as intended (the next frame's target)
held longer: the next frame is late
Animation error = animation time step − display time step: + shown too soon, − shown too late; error threshold 1 ms
